description: Ride-Along Reply (experimental) — Experimental reply or quote-post planner for borrowing reach from a larger account. Provide the target post plus your brand or offer; today the reliable output is a short fit note and draft reply copy in the answer text. You still approve and post it yourself. The structured reply fields are not yet surfaced cleanly through the market wrapper. (3 MESH/call, a tool · marketing)

brand.description: Your brand — who the reply is for.

offer.description: Your offer — what the reply should point at. Send brand or offer (or both).

target_post.description: REQUIRED — the larger account's post to reply to or quote (paste the text or its URL).
